fields.h1: Build a Job Application Form That Feeds Your Hiring Pipeline
fields.hero_description: Describe the role and what you need from each applicant. Emergent builds the job application form, resume uploads, and an applicant database you own, with no cap on applications.
fields.features_heading: What Every Job Application Form Needs
fields.features_subheading: A job application form asks every applicant for a role the same questions. Emergent builds yours, and the hiring steps after it.
fields.feature_1:
The sections hiring managers expect

Contact details, position, start date, work history, education, references, and a signed certification, generated from your prompt. Add or drop a question by describing it.
fields.feature_2:
One form for every open role

Applicants pick a position and then see only the questions written for it: a license number for nurses, a driving record for delivery staff, a portfolio link for designers.
fields.feature_3:
Resume and certificate uploads

Applicants attach a resume, cover letter, or license scan without creating an account. Each file is saved with its application, so a reviewer opens one record instead of an inbox.
fields.feature_4:
A print-ready PDF of each application

Every submission can produce a PDF in your layout for the personnel file. Locations that still hire on paper post a QR code at the counter that opens the same form on a phone.
fields.feature_5:
An applicant table with hiring stages

Each application becomes a row with role, location, stage, and owner. Applications are never capped. A new applicant sends a Slack or email alert to the hiring manager.
fields.feature_6:
Your careers page, your source code

Publish the form on your own domain or embed it in the careers page you have. The full source exports to your GitHub, so the hiring flow stays yours if engineering takes it over.

fields.usecase_heading: Job Application Forms for Every Hire
fields.tab_content_1:
An hourly job application that leads with availability

Applicants choose a store, mark the shifts they can work each week, and give a start date. Each application goes to that store's manager in Slack, and the applicant table shows who can cover weekends.
fields.tab_content_2:
A clinical job application that checks the license

Nurses and medical assistants enter a license number, issuing state, and expiry date, then upload their certifications. Any license that expires within 60 days is flagged for the recruiter before an interview is booked.
fields.tab_content_3:
An internal application that loops in the manager

Employees apply with their employee ID, current team, and months in role. The form checks tenure against the posting's minimum, alerts their current manager, and keeps internal applicants in a table of their own.
fields.tab_content_4:
A professional application that sorts by must-haves

Candidates upload a resume, add a portfolio link, confirm work authorization, and give a salary range. Applications that miss a must-have go to a hold list, and the rest reach the hiring manager in Slack as a shortlist.

fields.howto_title: How to Create a Job Application Form
fields.howto_description: Start from the role, not a blank template. Your questions and rules become the form, the uploads, the PDF copy, and the applicant database, in seven steps.
fields.howto_step_1_title: 01 Write down what the role requires
fields.howto_step_1_des: List what a hiring manager needs before a first call: availability, location, licenses, work authorization, and pay expectations. A question that would not change the decision stays off the form. Applicants on a phone will finish a short form on a break; a long one waits for later.
fields.howto_step_2_des: Most job application forms share one core: contact details, position and start date, work history, education, references, and a certification the applicant signs. Describe these once and Emergent generates them with the right field types for dates, phone numbers, and email.
fields.howto_step_3_des: Give each position its own questions. A nursing role asks for a license number and expiry date, a delivery role asks about a driver's license, and a design role asks for a portfolio. Applicants see only the questions for the role they pick.
fields.howto_step_4_des: Add uploads for a resume, cover letter, and any certificates the role calls for. Applicants attach files from a phone or laptop without making an account, and every file stays attached to its application record for the reviewer.
fields.howto_step_5_des: Choose who hears about each application and how: the store manager in Slack, the recruiter by email. Then set the stages an applicant moves through, from new to interview to offer, so the applicant table doubles as your hiring pipeline.
fields.howto_step_6_title: 06 Keep a PDF copy for records
fields.howto_step_6_des: If you keep personnel files or still take paper applications, ask for a PDF of each submission in your current layout. A QR code at the front counter sends walk-in applicants to the same online form, so every answer lands in one place.
fields.howto_step_7_des: Put the form on your careers page or your own domain, then submit a test application for every role. Confirm the right questions appear, the files attach, and the alert reaches the right person before the link goes out.
